propositions: Recursive conftest glob tests/**/conftest.py in global_support causes unrelated nested conftest changes to trigger all seven mutation shards, wasting 5.38 runner-hours across 97 runs without loading those fixtures.
Pytest loads only upward ancestor conftests in a test directory chain, never sibling fixture trees; runtime tracing across all configured shards found exactly six ancestor conftests actually loaded.
Exact per-shard conftest support mapping assigns each non-root conftest only to shards whose configured test paths have it as an ancestor, keeping only tests/conftest.py as true global support.

A derived ancestor-conftest equality contract expands configured test files, derives present ancestor conftests, and asserts per-shard support closure matches while pinning all pre-existing non-conftest globals and source/test mappings.
Defect-seeding proves contract fail-closed: removing a required interfaces dependency or adding stale Jira DC support entry each returned the contract to RED, killing 2 of 2 mutations.
Shard-test union remained 374 passed and 1 skipped with unchanged pass/skip results; no production capability, dependency, or test coverage was removed.
